Save an Editable Word Table

save_table1_docx.Rd

Writes the table as editable Word cells using officer and flextable. Uses automatic table layout, 0.7-inch margins, and repeating column headings. For especially wide tables use landscape orientation or a smaller font.

Usage

save_table1_docx(x, path, title = x$settings$title,
  landscape = FALSE, font_size = 10, font_family = "Arial",
  include_notes = TRUE, overwrite = FALSE)

Arguments

x

A nice_table1 object returned by nice_SMD_table1, or a nice_trial_table1 object returned by nice_trial_table1.

path

A single filename ending in .docx. The directory must already exist. An existing file is not replaced unless overwrite = TRUE.

title

A single character string used as a “Heading 1” paragraph above the table. Defaults to the title given to nice_SMD_table1. An empty string "" omits the heading.

landscape

TRUE or FALSE (default). Use landscape page orientation, recommended for tables with many groups or long labels.

font_size

A single positive number: font size in points. Default 10. Footnotes use max(8, font_size - 1).

font_family

A single character string naming the font. Default "Arial".

include_notes

TRUE (default) or FALSE. Include the footnotes stored in x$notes. Choose their detail level with the notes argument of nice_SMD_table1.

overwrite

TRUE or FALSE (default). Whether an existing file at path may be replaced.

Value

The normalized output path, invisibly.

See also

table1_flextable, nice_SMD_table1

Examples

d <- example_table1_data()
tab <- nice_SMD_table1(d, "group", c("age", "sex"),
  group_for_SMD = c("Control", "Treatment"))
path <- tempfile(fileext = ".docx")

## Default portrait document
save_table1_docx(tab, path)

## Replace an existing file; landscape page, smaller font, different typeface
save_table1_docx(tab, path, overwrite = TRUE, landscape = TRUE,
                 font_size = 9, font_family = "Times New Roman")

## Custom heading, or no heading at all
save_table1_docx(tab, path, overwrite = TRUE,
                 title = "Table 1. Baseline characteristics")
save_table1_docx(tab, path, overwrite = TRUE, title = "")

## Without footnotes ...
save_table1_docx(tab, path, overwrite = TRUE, include_notes = FALSE)

## ... or with a short legend, hiding Missing rows that are always zero
tab_short <- nice_SMD_table1(d, "group", c("age", "stratum"),
  group_for_SMD = c("Control", "Treatment"),
  show_missing = "if_any", notes = "short")
save_table1_docx(tab_short, path, overwrite = TRUE, landscape = TRUE)

## The path is returned invisibly
out <- save_table1_docx(tab, path, overwrite = TRUE)
basename(out) == basename(path)
#> [1] TRUE
unlink(path)
